report.method.text: Every test case was run on all models, in a random order in each iteration. Raters – humans and AI judges – saw the answers only as “Model 1, 2…”, never the model names. AI judges received the prompt, the expected answer (if any) and the anonymous answers. A “win” is the highest average in an iteration (ties count for everyone on top). Spread σ is the standard deviation of a model’s per-answer average ratings.
